description: Add a printable component (card deck, board, box, etc.) or stock part to a game. Use a catalog identity (e.g., 'BridgeDeck') for printable components, or a stock part UUID. Requires authentication.

game_id.description: The game ID to add the component to.

name.description: Optional display name for this component within the game (max 255 chars).

part_id.description: The component identity from the catalog (e.g., 'BridgeDeck', 'SmallTuckBox') or a stock part UUID.

quantity.description: Number of this component to include (e.g., 52 for a deck of cards).

name: add_component_to_game
